Title: Azure Service Fabric support for Docker Compose

Body.Content:
Docker uses the docker-compose.yml file for defining multi-container applications. To make it easy for customers familiar with Docker to orchestrate existing container applications on Service Fabric, we will include preview support for Docker Compose natively in the platform. Service Fabric will be able to accept version 3(+) of docker-compose.yml files. Since this support will soon be in preview, only a subset of Compose directives will besupported. For example, application upgrades won't be supported. However, you'll always be able to remove and deploy applications instead of upgrading them.

Read more about Azure Service Fabric support for Docker Compose.
